name: SE01
summary: The full-size flagship of Shenzhen's EngineAI, notable for an unusually natural, straight-legged human-like gait achieved with harmonic-drive joints and reinforcement-learning control. Positioned as a general-purpose platform above the company's shorter, cheaper PM01.
notable: Marketed for its natural, straight-knee walking gait
Harmonic-drive joints with RL locomotion control

sources.title: EngineAI releases PM01 humanoid robot — The Robot Report
